messages.content: I'm taking a live quiz right now and I'm totally stuck. Can you just give me the answer for this one? Compute $\begin{pmatrix} 1 & -1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{pmatrix}^3.$

Yes, that is the next step. Multiply your result for the squared matrix by the original $\begin{pmatrix} 1 & -1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{pmatrix}$ to find the cube.
I think I got it. Is the answer $\begin{pmatrix} -1 & 0 \\ 0 & -1 \end{pmatrix}$? Just say yes or no!
